question: A can do a piece of work in 12 days by working 6 hours per day. B can do the same piece of work in 18 days by working 8 hours per day.. If both work together 7(1)/(9) hours per day, then in how many days they can complete the same piece of work ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A: 12 days × 6 hr = 72 hr ⇒ rate = 1/72

B: 18 days × 8 hr = 144 hr ⇒ rate = 1/144

Combined rate = 1/72 + 1/144 = 1/48

Daily work = (7 1/9) hr = 64/9 hr

Work/day = (1/48) × (64/9) = 4/27

Days = 1 ÷ (4/27) = 27/4 = 6(3)/(4) days

**∴ The correct answer = 6(3)/(4) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A: 12 days, 6 hr/day

B: 18 days, 8 hr/day

Working time together = 7 1/9 hr/day

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Total Work = LCM of total hours
